_comment: Pick ONE of the two server blocks below and delete the other. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. Never commit real values.
_mode_1_proxy: PROXY MODE (recommended) - this process is a thin HTTP client for a bot you already run elsewhere. Setting BOT_API_URL is what selects this mode. No Discord token lives on this machine.
_mode_2_direct: DIRECT MODE - this process connects to Discord itself. Leave BOT_API_URL unset. Requires a Discord bot token.
